title: Desk System Reference: Booking a Settlement on Protection Coverage
content:
A claim that a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans answers for is settled by drawing benefit from the plan the covered piece stands on, and the benefit it draws is worked out from the bench work the repair comes to rather than from the figure the customer reported the loss as. Settling the claim books one settlement entry against the coverage, and what the customer can afterwards see is the claim answered, the benefit drawn against it and what they are left to pay themselves.

## How the action is taken

The desk unlocks the tool `record_claim_settlement_8eb9093c` and calls it. One call answers one claim in full: a settlement entry is written against the coverage under the claim's own reference, carrying the benefit consumed as a movement out of the plan's benefit allowance, the out-of-pocket amount the customer bears on this claim, and a pointer back to the entry on which the loss was first entered, from which the piece, the kind of loss and the bench work order are carried over unchanged. The coverage's count of claims settled over its life goes up by one.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `protection_plan_id` | the reference number of the coverage record the claim stands against, as returned by the protection coverage lookup | an id |
| `claim_reference` | the reference the claim already carries, read from the entry on which the loss was entered against this coverage | CL- followed by six digits, for example CL-330871 |
| `source_entry_id` | the reference number of the coverage entry on which the loss was first entered, as returned by the coverage history lookup; the settlement is recorded as the answer to that entry | an id |
| `benefit_amount` | the benefit this settlement consumes, booked as a movement out of the benefit allowance | a positive amount in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only |
| `deductible_charged` | what the customer pays out of pocket toward this settlement | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even; 0.00 where nothing is charged to them |

## What comes back

A single confirmation line naming the reference number minted for the settlement entry, the claim reference it was booked under, the benefit consumed in USD and the out-of-pocket amount recorded, plus the coverage's new count of claims settled. The line being returned at all is what indicates the entry was written; afterwards the settlement appears in the coverage history under that claim reference.
